overview: Teaching in India is widely undervalued by 12th-graders chasing engineering or medicine, but the 2026 reality is striking — KVS recruitment alone announced 9,126 vacancies; combined KVS-NVS opened 5,841 more posts. Central govt teachers (KVS, NVS) earn ₹35K-1.4L/month with full govt benefits, lifetime pension, and one of the most stable career arcs in India. State TET-cleared teachers in Delhi, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu earn ₹40-70K/month at govt schools. The newer growth segments are Special Education (severe national shortage, RCI-mandated qualification), International School teaching (IB/Cambridge curricula paying ₹70K-2L/month), and EdTech (post-2023 stabilization, Vedantu/PhysicsWallah/Unacademy hiring at ₹15-50L for top teachers). The hidden gem is Higher Education via UGC NET — Assistant Professor at central university starts ₹57K and the role offers extraordinary autonomy.
key_insights: KVS PGT salary (Level 7, ₹44,900-1,42,400) is comparable to a private engineer's salary at TCS/Infosys but with central govt job security, summer/winter vacations, and pension benefits.

Special Educators (RCI-registered) face a national shortage — 26.8M Indians have disabilities; supply of trained special educators is under 50,000. Govt special educator pay ₹7.2 LPA avg — strong unmet demand.

International school teachers (IB Diploma, Cambridge IGCSE, Edexcel) at premium schools (Dhirubhai Ambani International, Pathways, Ecole Mondiale) earn ₹70K-2L/month with international placement opportunities.
EdTech crashed in 2023-24 (BYJU's collapse, Unacademy layoffs) but stabilized — top math/physics/chemistry teachers at PhysicsWallah, Vedantu earn ₹15-50 LPA on permanent rolls; star teachers ₹1 Cr+.
UGC NET-qualified Assistant Professor at central university starts ₹57,700 (Level 10) — same scale as IAS at entry — but most students never consider this stable, autonomous career.

sub_paths.name: B.Ed (General Teacher Preparation)
sub_paths.description: 2-year Bachelor of Education — the standard professional teacher training degree. Mandatory for govt/most private school teaching.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; need any UG with 50%+ for B.Ed (45% reserved)
sub_paths.entrance_exam: State B.Ed entrance (UP B.Ed JEE, MAH B.Ed CET, AP EdCET, JMI EE), CUET PG (some), university tests
top_institutions: Tata Institute of Social Sciences Mumbai (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA in Education / M.Ed at Harvard GSE, Stanford GSE, Cambridge, IOE London, OISE Toronto. Strong demand for Indian teachers in UAE, Singapore, UK schools.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Year 1: theory of education, child psychology, pedagogy. Year 2: 16+ weeks teaching practicum at partner schools. Significant micro-teaching, lesson planning.
sub_paths.growth_path: B.Ed → State TET / CTET → Govt school teacher (PRT/TGT/PGT) or private school. Mid-career M.Ed for academic/admin roles.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher (private school): 2.5-5 LPA / Govt school post-TET: 4-9 LPA / Mid: 8-18 LPA / Senior: 15-30 LPA. Note: Pay depends entirely on next-stage exam (CTET/TET/KVS) and school type. Source: NCS, Govt teaching scale.

sub_paths.name: CTET (Central Teacher Eligibility Test)
sub_paths.description: CBSE-conducted national TET exam. Mandatory qualifier for KVS, NVS, central govt schools, many private schools.
sub_paths.qualification: Paper I (Class 1-5): 12th + 2-yr D.El.Ed/B.El.Ed/B.Ed; Paper II (Class 6-8): UG + B.Ed
sub_paths.duration: Twice yearly cycle (~6 months); certificate valid lifetime since 2021
top_institutions: DIET (District Institute of Education and Training) free coaching at some centres
scholarships: State free coaching for SC/ST/EWS via DIETs and TET cells
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Not directly used abroad; CTET cert is India-specific.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Test of pedagogy, child psychology, language, math/science/social science. Two papers — primary or upper-primary level.
sub_paths.growth_path: CTET cert → KVS/NVS apply → state DSSSB/TGT/PRT exams → Central or state govt teacher post.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Post-CTET hiring: PRT ₹29,200-92,300 (Level 5); TGT ₹35,400-1,12,400 (Level 6); PGT ₹44,900-1,42,400 (Level 7). Note: CTET itself is qualifier, not job; pay comes from KVS/NVS recruitment. Source: KVS, 7th Pay.

sub_paths.name: KVS / NVS Recruitment (Central Govt Teaching)
sub_paths.description: Kendriya Vidyalaya / Navodaya Vidyalaya — central govt school teachers (PRT, TGT, PGT) with central pay scales and lifetime benefits.
sub_paths.qualification: PRT: 12th + D.El.Ed + CTET I; TGT: UG + B.Ed + CTET II; PGT: PG + B.Ed
sub_paths.duration: Annual exam cycle ~9-10 months; service training in Mussoorie/regional
sub_paths.entrance_exam: KVS-NVS Common Recruitment Exam (CBSE) — 9,126 KVS vacancies; 5,841 KVS-NVS combined for 2026
top_institutions: Free DIET-affiliated coaching at some centres
scholarships: AISECT KVS coaching for rural aspirants
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: KVS/NVS run schools in some Embassy locations (Moscow, Tehran, Kathmandu). Direct foreign deputation rare.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Class teaching, lesson planning, exam evaluation, student counselling, school admin. KV/NV schools well-equipped; postings rotate every 5-7 yrs.
sub_paths.growth_path: PRT → senior PRT → Vice Principal → Principal. TGT/PGT similar ladder. Departmental promotion exams accelerate. Lifetime pension.
sub_paths.salary_bands: PRT (Level 5): 5-8 LPA gross / TGT (Level 6): 7-11 LPA / PGT (Level 7): 8-14 LPA. Mid-career (10-15 yr): 12-22 LPA. Principal (Level 12): 18-30 LPA. Note: Vacations + pension + housing make total comp 30-50% above stated cash. Source: KVS, 7th Pay 2025-26.

sub_paths.name: State TETs / State Govt Teaching
sub_paths.description: State Teacher Eligibility Tests — UPTET, Maharashtra TAIT, MPTET, Bihar TET etc. — for state govt school teaching jobs.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: UPTET, BiETET, MPTET, MAHA TAIT, REET (Rajasthan), KARTET, TNTET, APTET
top_institutions: Free state govt SC/ST coaching schemes via DIETs
scholarships: State DIET free coaching schemes for reserved categories
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Not direct; state-cert teachers can move to international schools after CIDTT/CELTA certifications.
sub_paths.day_in_life: State govt school class teaching; postings often rural/semi-urban early career; transfers hard. Full state govt benefits.
sub_paths.growth_path: Asst Teacher → Senior → Headmaster → BEO/DIO admin roles. State Pay Level 6-10 depending on state.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-7 LPA / Mid: 7-14 LPA / Senior: 12-25 LPA. Note: Maharashtra/Karnataka pay slightly above UP/Bihar; metro postings (Delhi DSSSB) higher. Source: state pay commissions, 7th Pay.

sub_paths.name: UGC NET (College/University Lecturer)
sub_paths.description: UGC NET qualifies for Assistant Professor at universities/colleges and JRF for PhD funding. Path to academic career.
sub_paths.qualification: PG (any subject) with 55%; UGC NET clear
sub_paths.private_fees: Coaching ₹15K-50K (Plutus IAS NET, Eduncle, KVS Madaan)
top_institutions: Free state-funded UGC coaching at minority universities
scholarships: UGC NET-JRF stipend ₹37K/month for 2 yrs + ₹42K next 3 yrs
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: PhD programs abroad — Cambridge, Oxford, top US universities. Indian academics with UGC-NET + PhD often shift to UAE, Singapore universities mid-career.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Asst Professor: teaching ~6-9 hrs/week + research + admin. Strong autonomy; long vacations. PhD route: 4-6 yrs of research + dissertation.
sub_paths.growth_path: Asst Prof (Level 10, ₹57,700) → Asso Prof (Level 13A, ₹1,31,400) → Professor (Level 14, ₹1,44,200). Central univ + IIT/IISER faculty get research grants too.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher (Asst Prof): 8-13 LPA / Mid (Asso Prof): 18-30 LPA / Senior (Professor): 25-50 LPA. Note: Same scale at central univs, IITs, IIMs. Plus consultancy, summer school stipends. Source: 7th Pay UGC scale, AICTE.

sub_paths.name: Special Education (B.Ed Special Education / RCI)
sub_paths.description: RCI-regulated B.Ed Special Education — train to teach children with disabilities (autism, dyslexia, hearing/visual impairment). Massive shortage in India.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; need UG with 50%+ for B.Ed Special Ed
sub_paths.qualification: B.Ed Special Education (2 yr) + RCI registration (CRR number)
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CUCET, IGNOU OPENMAT, JMI EE, state B.Ed JEE; institute entrance
top_institutions: Jamia Millia Islamia Delhi B.Ed Special (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: USA (BCBA certification for Applied Behavior Analysis), UK (PG Cert in SEN at Cambridge, Oxford), Australia (AHPRA for psychology-adjacent roles). Strong demand.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Individualized Education Plans (IEPs), one-on-one therapy, classroom shadowing in inclusive schools, parent collaboration. Demanding but high impact.
sub_paths.growth_path: Special Educator → Senior → SEN Coordinator → Inclusion Director. Govt route via DSSSB, KVS Special Educator posts, state recruitments. Private clinics, NGOs (NIPCCD, Prerna).
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2.5-5 LPA (private) / 6-8 LPA (govt) / Mid: 6-12 LPA / Senior: 12-25 LPA. Note: Govt special educator avg ₹7.2 LPA; ABA therapists at private centres ₹4-8L; abroad $50-75K. Source: getmyuni, RCI registry.

sub_paths.name: EdTech Teaching Career
sub_paths.description: Online teaching at PhysicsWallah, Vedantu, Unacademy, Adda247, Khan Academy India. Sector stabilized post-2024 crash; star teachers earn premiums.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; need subject expertise + UG; B.Ed not always required
sub_paths.qualification: Subject mastery (UG/PG); demo class clearance with platform
sub_paths.duration: Varies; many top EdTech teachers self-trained or coaching-industry veterans
scholarships: Most EdTech offers free intro courses; Khan Academy fully free
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Cross-border online teaching at Nearpod, Outschool, Cambly, Preply. UAE/Saudi/SE Asia online tutoring market growing.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Recording/streaming live classes (1-3 hrs/day), doubt-solving sessions, content creation (notes, MCQs), social-media engagement.
sub_paths.growth_path: Educator → Senior Educator → Star Teacher → Subject Lead. Top math/physics teachers (Alakh Pandey style) earn ₹1-5 Cr+ via revenue share + ESOPs.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-12 LPA / Mid: 12-35 LPA / Senior (star): 50 LPA-2 Cr+. Note: Pay highly variable; permanent salaries lower than star/freelance teachers; PhysicsWallah top earners ₹50L-1Cr+. Source: AmbitionBox, founder disclosures.

sub_paths.name: International School Teaching (IB / Cambridge / Edexcel)
sub_paths.description: Teaching IB Diploma, IGCSE, Cambridge A-Levels, Edexcel curricula at premium international schools.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; need UG/PG + IB/Cambridge teacher certification
sub_paths.qualification: UG + B.Ed + IB workshop / Cambridge IGCSE training / PGCEi
sub_paths.govt_fees: B.Ed govt fees as per state
scholarships: Limited; some schools sponsor IB workshops for hired teachers
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Strong direct route — IB-certified teachers in demand at international schools globally (UAE, Singapore, Bangkok, Hong Kong, Dubai). Pay 2-3x India.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Class teaching with smaller batches (15-20 students), assessment-driven curriculum, parent meetings, IB MYP/DP curriculum planning. Strong work-life balance.
sub_paths.growth_path: Subject Teacher → Coordinator (IB DP/MYP) → Head of Department → Principal/Head. International school principal in UAE/Singapore ₹1-3 Cr+.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 8-15 LPA / Mid: 15-30 LPA / Senior (HoD/Principal): 25-80 LPA. Note: Top Mumbai/Delhi int'l schools ₹70K-2L/month; UAE/Singapore int'l 30-80L. Source: int'l school disclosures, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Educational Counselling / Career Counsellor
sub_paths.description: Career counselling for students — admissions guidance, study abroad, mental health support. Growing post-NEP 2020.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; need UG + counselling cert (Psychology UG/PG strongly preferred)
sub_paths.qualification: BA/MA Psychology + Career Counselling cert; or B.Ed + counselling specialty
sub_paths.entrance_exam: Univ entrances; CUET; private institute exams
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA Counselling Psychology in USA (Columbia TC, NYU, UPenn), UK (UCL IOE), Australia (Melbourne) — ₹30-60L. Direct school counsellor roles in UAE/Singapore.
sub_paths.day_in_life: 1:1 counselling sessions, school visits, study-abroad guidance, career assessments. Mix of in-person and online. NEP 2020 has mandated career counsellors in schools.
sub_paths.growth_path: Counsellor → Senior → Head of Counselling → Director. Private practice viable; study-abroad consultants (Edwise, Yocket) hire heavily.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3-7 LPA / Mid: 7-15 LPA / Senior: 15-35 LPA. Note: Top study-abroad consultants 8-15L; school counsellors 4-8L; private practice variable. Source: AmbitionBox, NCS.

sub_paths.name: Academic Administration / Principal Track
sub_paths.description: School/college administration — Vice-Principal, Principal, Director, Dean. Combines teaching experience with management.
sub_paths.qualification: M.Ed / MA Education + 10-15 yr teaching experience; PGDM Education for HE admin
sub_paths.duration: Career path; not a single degree
sub_paths.entrance_exam: School-board / private school direct hire; UPSC for KV/NV Principals
sub_paths.private_fees: PGDM Education ₹3-15 lakh (TISS, IIM-A FPM, Ahmedabad Univ)
top_institutions: TISS Mumbai School of Education (govt, MA Education leadership)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: EdD or M.Ed Educational Leadership at Harvard, Stanford, IOE London, Toronto. Strong demand for international school principals globally.
sub_paths.day_in_life: School admin, staff hiring, student discipline, parent liaison, board interaction, financial planning. Strategic + people-heavy.
sub_paths.growth_path: Senior Teacher → Head of Department → Vice Principal → Principal → Director/Dean. Private school principal salaries vary by tier.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Vice Principal: 8-18 LPA / Principal (mid-tier): 12-30 LPA / Principal (top private): 30-80 LPA. Note: KVS/NVS Principal Level 12 ₹78,800-2,09,200; top international school principals ₹50L-1.5 Cr. Source: 7th Pay, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Teacher Training College Faculty / Education Research
sub_paths.description: Lecturers/professors at teacher-education colleges (DIETs, B.Ed colleges, RIE, NCERT). Research at education think tanks.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; need M.Ed + UGC NET + PhD often
sub_paths.entry_route: Degree → Govt exam (UGC NET / state exams)
sub_paths.qualification: M.Ed + UGC NET / NCTE faculty norms; PhD for senior posts
sub_paths.duration: B.Ed 2 yr + M.Ed 2 yr + PhD 4-6 yr
sub_paths.entrance_exam: UGC NET (Education); state-specific lecturer recruitment (UPLRT, Bihar STET)
sub_paths.govt_fees: B.Ed + M.Ed govt fees ₹50K-1.5 lakh total
top_institutions: Tata Institute of Social Sciences Mumbai (govt)
Ambedkar University Delhi School of Education (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: PhD Education at Harvard GSE, Stanford GSE, IOE London, OISE Toronto. Visiting fellowships at Brookings, RAND education research.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Mix of teaching pre-service teachers, research, NCERT textbook writing, policy briefs. Slower-paced than school teaching; deep autonomy.
sub_paths.growth_path: Asst Professor → Asso Professor → Professor → Director. NCERT/NIEPA director-level roles ₹2-3L/month plus admin posts.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Asst Prof (UGC scale Level 10): 8-13 LPA / Asso Prof: 18-28 LPA / Prof: 25-45 LPA. Note: Same UGC pay as central university; research grants add. Source: UGC pay scale, NCERT.

sub_paths.name: Early Childhood Care & Education (ECCE)
sub_paths.description: Pre-primary teaching (NTT, NCC, Montessori, Reggio Emilia). Growing rapidly under NEP 2020 foundational learning push.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 12th 50% for NTT/Diploma; UG for higher pre-primary
sub_paths.qualification: Nursery Teacher Training (NTT) 1 yr / Diploma in ECCE 2 yr / B.El.Ed 4 yr
sub_paths.private_fees: ₹50K-2 lakh total (Indus Tree Crafts, KIIT, Montessori India)
top_institutions: Montessori Training Centre Hyderabad (private, Montessori cert)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Montessori AMI/AMS certification globally recognized. Strong demand at Singapore, UAE, Hong Kong international preschools.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Pre-primary classes, play-based learning, parent communication, child development tracking. Lower stress than primary; high physical engagement.
sub_paths.growth_path: Nursery Teacher → Senior Pre-K → Coordinator → Pre-Primary Director / School Principal. International Montessori network for global movement.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 2-4 LPA / Mid: 4-10 LPA / Senior (Director): 10-25 LPA. Note: Premium Montessori chains (Bachpan, Kidzee, Eurokids) Director roles 12-25L; UAE pre-K teachers ₹15-30L. Source: AmbitionBox, NCS.

sub_paths.name: PhD / Research Track (Pre-Faculty)
sub_paths.description: Direct path to academic research career — IIT/IISER/IIM/central university PhDs as pre-faculty pipeline.
sub_paths.entry_route: Govt exam (UGC NET-JRF, GATE for IIT, JEST, etc.)
sub_paths.qualification: PG with 55%; PhD admission via JRF/GATE/institute entrance + interview
sub_paths.duration: PhD 4-6 years; sometimes Integrated MS-PhD 5 yrs
sub_paths.entrance_exam: UGC NET-JRF, GATE, CSIR NET, JEST, IIT JAM (for MSc → PhD), institute-specific
sub_paths.private_fees: Limited private PhD; OPJU, Symbiosis, Manipal ₹1-3 lakh/yr
top_institutions: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad/Bangalore FPM (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Direct PhD abroad — funded at MIT, Stanford, Harvard, Cambridge, ETH, Max Planck. Postdoc routes after Indian PhD common.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Research lab work, paper writing, conference presentations, teaching assistant duties. Long hours but flexible; PhD years are formative for academic career.
sub_paths.growth_path: PhD → Postdoc (1-3 yr) → Asst Prof → Asso Prof → Prof. INSPIRE Faculty Award post-PhD gives 5 yrs ₹35K stipend + ₹35L research grant. Strong industry exits to R&D roles.
sub_paths.salary_bands: PhD stipend: 4-5 LPA / Postdoc: 6-12 LPA / Asst Prof (post-PhD): 8-13 LPA / Mid (Asso Prof): 18-30 LPA / Senior (Prof): 25-50 LPA. Note: Industry R&D scientist 15-30L; data science exit even higher. Source: UGC, CSIR.

data_confidence_notes: KVS 9,126 vacancies and KVS-NVS 5,841 combined verified for 2026; salary scales (Level 5/6/7) verified from 7th Pay Commission and KVS 2026 notification.
CTET cert is now lifetime-valid since 2021; UGC NET-JRF stipend ₹37-42K confirmed.
EdTech salaries flagged 'medium' confidence — sector volatility post-2024 BYJU's collapse means data is rapidly changing; star teacher comp varies hugely by platform and revenue-share deals.
Special Education salaries verified via getmyuni, RCI registry, and HPRCA 2025-26 recruitment notification (270 special-educator vacancies).
ECCE/Pre-primary salaries are relatively undocumented; ranges based on Bachpan/Kidzee/Eurokids public salary disclosures + AmbitionBox.
